question: According to IEEE Std 802.11-2020, when can an HT STA transmit a frame with LDPC coding? [IEEE 802.11]
options: When the Rx LDPC subfield of the HT Capabilities element contains a value of 1
When the dot11LDPCCodingOptionActivated is true
When the TXVECTOR parameter FORMAT is set to HT_MF or HT_GF
When the RA of the frame corresponds to an HT STA
When the TXVECTOR parameter FEC_CODING is set to LDPC_CODING
correct_answer: When the Rx LDPC subfield of the HT Capabilities element contains a value of 1

question: What is a beacon integrity group temporal key (BIGTK)?
options: A random value, assigned by the access point (AP), used for protecting Beacon frames.
The difference between the center frequencies of two non-overlapping and adjacent channels.
A matrix used to determine the channel between a transmitter and an intended receiver.
A matrix that maps from space-time streams to transmit antennas to improve signal power or signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) at an intended receiver.
The process of changing the association of a station (STA) from one BSS to another BSS within the same ESS.
correct_answer: A random value, assigned by the access point (AP), used for protecting Beacon frames.
